synopsis: UAS Visual Observer reported a fly away after a lost link with the controller. The UAS crashed in an area of trees and was recovered by the UAS crew.
narrative: The pilot lifted off and got to around 50 ft. to do his movement checks before beginning his flight. The UAV began to rotate in a circle; the pilot released his thumbs from the controls and then the UAV did a hard left bank and flew fast and straight for about 700+ ft. at the same height of 50 ft. until it reached a nearby tree line where it crashed into a tree and fell to the ground. There was no damage to property and injury to human. The UAV was quickly located and all of the parts that fell off. Looking at the flight data shows a flyaway with no stick movement of any kind. This is the second time this UAV has had a flyaway.
